inventory.visualPurpose: The Biologic agents naming table (book 254): the drug-stem decoder for the biologics — 3 group banners and 11 rows, columns ENDING / CATEGORY / EXAMPLE, from -ximab/rituximab through -kinra/anakinra — the Pharmacology chapter's closing table
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: COLOR-CODED TABLE, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM-read at 120dpi, staging-ph28/vlm-census.txt — VLM available this session): the section header band (book page 254, SEC TION II, PHARMACOLOGY, '▶ PHARMACOLOGY—MISCELLANEOUS'), the dark navy table title 'Biologic agents', three column headers ENDING / CATEGORY / EXAMPLE, then three shaded group banner rows spanning all columns — 'Monoclonal antibodies (-mab)—target overexpressed cell surface receptors'; 'Small molecule inhibitors (-ib)—target intracellular molecules'; 'Interleukin receptor modulators (-kin)—agonists and antagonists of interleukin receptors' — and 11 data rows in printed order: -ximab → Chimeric human-mouse monoclonal antibody → Rituximab; -zumab → Humanized monoclonal antibody → Bevacizumab; -umab → Human monoclonal antibody → Denosumab; -ciclib → Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor → Palbociclib; -coxib → COX-2 inhibitor → Celecoxib; -parib → Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor → Olaparib; -rafenib → BRAF inhibitor → Vemurafenib; -tinib → Tyrosine kinase inhibitor → Imatinib; -zomib → Proteasome inhibitor → Bortezomib; -leukin → Interleukin-2 agonist/analog → Aldesleukin; -kinra → Interleukin receptor antagonist → Anakinra. Red mnemonic letters print INSIDE the CATEGORY cells (Chi-meric, Humanized, Human, Cyclin-, COX-2, Poly, BRAF, Tyrosine kinase, Proteasome, Interleukin-2, interleukin 'r'eceptor 'a'ntagonist) plus red banner fragments; the table occupies the top ~40% of the short final page; no figures, icons, margin notes, or asterisk footnotes.
inventory.kypLocation: the whole registry visual (BiologicAgentsMap in visuals/pharm-p28.tsx): Zone A the -mab humanization ladder as three color-coded Y-shaped antibodies with the three printed rows (-ximab/Chimeric human-mouse/Rituximab, -zumab/Humanized/Bevacizumab, -umab/Human/Denosumab); Zone B the format-follows-the-target cell-crossing panel with the -mab antibody outside the plasma membrane at overexpressed surface receptors and the six -ib machines inside the cell (-ciclib/-coxib/-parib/-rafenib/-tinib/-zomib with their printed categories and examples); Zone C the -kin see-saw (-leukin/Interleukin-2 agonist-analog/Aldesleukin vs -kinra/Interleukin receptor antagonist/Anakinra); Zone D the four-move decode protocol strip; the table's full text is ALSO carried verbatim in the note's table block (blocks[1]), core.what, list block (blocks[2]), and recall[0-7]
